services.desc: While designed primarily as a display garden, some areas in Allerton Garden focus on distinct collections. One section is devoted to an impressive collection of plants in the order Zingiberales, which includes Heliconia (in the Heliconiaceae), Costus (spiral gingers, in the Costaceae or Costus family), Calathea (in the Marantaceae or Prayer Plant family), and Etlingera (torch gingers in the Zingiberaceae or Ginger family). blurb: Feed your inner plant explorer at The Kampong! Dr. David Fairchild, the famous plant explorer who used to live here, named the garden for the villages he encountered in Malaysia. Today, we invite you to deepen your relationship with plants at this botanic garden and community space.
